title: Llama 3.1 Release
summary: Meta publicly released Llama 3.1 on July 23, 2024. The release included Llama 3.1 405B and upgraded 8B and 70B models; Meta stated that the models were available that day for download and immediate development through partner platforms.
significance: A dated release milestone in the Llama model family that introduced the 405B model alongside upgraded 8B and 70B models, with 128K context length and multilingual support across eight languages.
